profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | General with Go, Python, Node.js, and lots of Kubernetes
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer at Duke Energy
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Atolio, I develop backend components for an AI-driven enterprise search solution that enables organizations to access and leverage their data across multiple platforms and sources. I work primarily in Go, but also in Python, Java, and bash, depending on the project needs and challenges.

With over eight years of experience in web technologies and cloud computing, I have a strong background in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and efficient solutions based on Cloud Foundry and Kubernetes. I have also led the development of frameworks and tools for testing, deployment, and automation, as well as the migration of legacy systems to modern architectures. I am passionate about software quality and architecture and want to be part of a community of craftspeople who believe that quality code is not just a means, but an end in itself.

● Worked primarily in Go, but also in Python, Java, and bash
